title: Legal Executive
description:
LEGAL EXECUTIVE – REAL ESTATE

**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Industry:** Real Estate / Construction  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a **Legal Executive** with 1–3 years of experience to support our legal and documentation activities related to real estate projects, land transactions, registrations, agreements, and statutory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist in preparing, reviewing, and maintaining legal documents, agreements, deeds, and contracts.
* Handle and verify property-related documents including sale deeds, title documents, EC, patta, chitta, FMB, approvals, and other land records.
* Assist in **land due diligence and title verification**.
* Coordinate with advocates, government authorities, registration offices, and other external stakeholders.
* Support property registration, document execution, and related legal formalities.
* Assist in preparing and reviewing **sale agreements, construction agreements, development agreements, POA, and other real estate documents**.
* Maintain proper records of legal documents and ensure timely follow-up on pending matters.
* Assist the senior legal team in land acquisition, subdivision, joint ventures, and property-related transactions.
* Track legal cases, notices, registrations, and documentation requirements.
* Conduct basic legal research and provide necessary support to the management.
* Ensure confidentiality and proper handling of company and property documents.

Required Skills

* **LL.B / B.L degree** from a recognized university.
* 1–3 years of experience in **real estate, construction, corporate legal, or property law**.
* Good knowledge of property documentation and registration procedures.
* Good drafting and documentation skills.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in **English and Tamil**.
* Good knowledge of MS Office and document management.
* Ability to handle multiple legal documents and follow up independently.

Preferred

* Candidates with experience in a **real estate or construction company** will be preferred.
* Knowledge of **RERA, property laws, registration procedures, and land documentation** will be an advantage.
* Willingness to travel to registration offices, government departments, and project sites when required.

Key Competencies

**Legal Documentation | Property Due Diligence | Land Records | Registration | Legal Research | Drafting | Coordination | Follow-up | Attention to Detail**

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Corporate Lawyer
description:
**Company Name:** RABWIN MOULDSMITH PVT LTD  
**Position:** Corporate Advocate / Legal Counsel  
**Department:** Legal & Compliance  
**Location:** Malumichampatti, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time / Retainer Basis (as applicable)  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Corporate Advocate to handle the company's legal matters, ensure statutory compliance, review business agreements, manage legal documentation, and represent the company in legal proceedings when required. The candidate should have strong knowledge of corporate laws, labour laws, commercial contracts, and industrial legal requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle the company's legal matters, disputes, notices, and litigation.
* Draft, review, and verify agreements, contracts, legal notices, undertakings, and other legal documents.
* Advise management on corporate law, labour law, employment matters, and business-related legal issues.
* Ensure compliance with applicable company laws, industrial regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Handle employee-related legal matters, disciplinary issues, employment disputes, and termination-related documentation.
* Review vendor agreements, purchase contracts, customer agreements, confidentiality agreements, and other commercial documents.
* Coordinate with external advocates, legal consultants, government departments, and courts as required.
* Manage legal notices, claims, recovery proceedings, and responses to legal communications.
* Provide legal support for company property, financial transactions, debt recovery, and contractual disputes.
* Maintain proper records of legal documents, case files, agreements, compliance documents, and court proceedings.
* Identify potential legal risks and recommend suitable preventive measures to management.
* Support management in legal due diligence and other legal matters related to business operations.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) from a recognized institution.
* Must be enrolled with the appropriate State Bar Council and eligible to practise law, wherever required for the role.
* Knowledge of corporate law, labour law, contract law, and commercial litigation.
* Experience handling industrial, manufacturing, or corporate clients is preferred.

Required Skills

* Strong legal drafting and documentation skills.
* Good communication, negotiation, and analytical abilities.
* Knowledge of applicable Indian laws and statutory compliance.
* Ability to handle confidential company information responsibly.
* Strong problem-solving and case-management skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with management, HR, Accounts, vendors, and external legal professionals.

Preferred Experience

* Experience working with manufacturing companies, private limited companies, or industrial establishments.
* Familiarity with employment disputes, vendor and customer contracts, debt recovery, and commercial litigation.
* Experience dealing with labour authorities, government departments, and courts.

Reporting To

Management / Director

Application Process

Interested candidates may submit their updated resume mentioning their legal experience, qualifications, areas of specialization, and expected remuneration.

Pay: ₹13,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Associate (Corporate & Litigation)
description:
**Key Responsibilities**  
**Corporate and commercial drafting**  
1. Drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements, including manufacturing, supply and licensing agreements  
2. Drafting shareholders' agreements, debenture agreements and related transaction documents  
3. Preparing corporate-commercial documentation such as board and shareholder resolutions, notices and ancillary deeds  
4. Preparing legal opinions, notices and correspondence  
**Litigation and dispute resolution**  
1. Drafting pleadings, including plaints, written statements, petitions, counter-affidavits, applications and appeals  
2. Appearing in and conducting hearings before civil courts, the High Court, tribunals and other judicial and quasi-judicial forums  
3. Tracking matters, managing case files and coordinating with clients and counsel  
**Tamil-language work**   
1. Reading and interpreting legal documents in Tamil, including title deeds, revenue records, pleadings and orders  
2. Drafting correspondence and documents in Tamil where required  
**Qualifications and Skills Required**   
1. LL.B. (3-year or 5-year) from a recognised university  
2. Enrolled as an advocate with the Bar Council of Tamil Nadu and Puducherry, or eligible to practise in Tamil Nadu  
3. At least 1.5 years of post-qualification experience in litigation and/or corporate-commercial practice  
4. Strong legal drafting skills in English  
5. Ability to read, write and interpret legal documents in Tamil  
6. Working knowledge of civil procedure and the conduct of court proceedings  
**Preferred**   
1. Knowledge of Hindi  
2. Exposure to both transactional drafting and court practice  
**How to Apply**   
The role is full-time and office-based: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., at the Coimbatore office, with court attendance as matters require.  
Interested candidates may send the following to **info@lexworthlaw.com:**   
1. Curriculum vitae, with Bar Council enrolment number and year of enrolment  
2. A short note on experience in drafting and court practice  
3. One writing sample (an agreement or a pleading, with client details redacted)

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Experience:

* litigation and/or corporate-commercial practice: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Document Control Coordinator - Life Sciences & Quality Compliance**
=====================================================================

**Location :-** Coimbatore

**Experience :-** 4+ Years

*Choosing Capgemini means choosing a place where you'll be empowered to shape your career, supported by a collaborative global community, and inspired to reimagine what's possible. Join us in helping leading Life Sciences organizations strengthen quality compliance, ensure regulatory readiness, and drive operational excellence through robust document management and quality systems.*

**Your Role**
-------------

As a **Document Control Coordinator - Life Sciences & Quality Compliance** , you will support the administration and execution of controlled quality documents across their lifecycle. You will ensure document accuracy, compliance with QMS procedures, audit readiness, and effective coordination between document owners, reviewers, approvers, and stakeholders in a regulated Life Sciences environment.

  

**In this role, you will:**
---------------------------

* Execute new document creation, revisions, periodic reviews, publication, archival, retirement, and document lifecycle activities.
* Review documents for formatting standards, template compliance, metadata accuracy, version control, and completeness.
* Initiate, maintain, and monitor QMS workflows while coordinating with document owners, reviewers, approvers, and training teams.
* Maintain document control records, document numbering systems, workflow status, repository data, and audit trails.
* Track open requests, SLA commitments, and due dates, escalating risks and bottlenecks as required.
* Support document retrieval, traceability, regulatory inspections, audits, and evidence preparation activities.
* Generate KPI/SLA reports, backlog metrics, compliance dashboards, and process status reports.
* Ensure adherence to document management procedures while protecting data integrity and record accuracy.

**Your Profile**
----------------

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Medical Sciences, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related discipline.
* 4+ years of experience in Document Control, Document Management, Quality Operations, Regulatory Support, Compliance, or related functions.
* Mandatory experience in Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, Medical Device, Healthcare, Medical, or other regulated industries.
* Hands-on experience within Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Systems (QMS), or regulated operational environments.
* Strong understanding of controlled document lifecycle management, records management, audit readiness, and data integrity principles.
* Experience working with Electronic Document Management Systems (eDMS) or controlled repositories such as:
  + Veeva Vault
  + MasterControl
  + OpenText / Documentum
  + TrackWise
  + Equivalent QMS/eDMS platforms
